_comment: The replication package's menu fragment (warehouse §4.2, owner decision 2026-10-20): "Replication requests" for the
administrators who approve what other modules may read (shown only to callers holding the query's right, i.e. the
group the application binds to replication:approvers), and "My pending changes" for anyone whose edit of a replica
waits at its owner or ended without being applied. Ids are UUIDv5 of 'replication:programUnits.…'.
An application removes a unit with { "id": "…", "$remove": true } in its own programUnits.json.
